headline: Pakistan and Turkmenistan Discuss Central Asian Transit and Direct Cargo Corridors
summary: Pakistan proposed new trade corridors, direct flights, and trucking routes through Turkmenistan during bilateral commerce talks to circumvent regional freight disruptions and lower export transit costs.
why: Pakistan seeks to expand trade access to Central Asian landlocked markets to boost manufacturing and agricultural export earnings.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Developing overland trade corridors lowers logistical expense for bilateral commerce.
